kinetic_energy_density.integral_vs_kinet.note: relative: int tau = sum_k w tr(P T_k) with the kinetic matrix of _kinetic; int tau = 7.4641

kinetic_energy_density.min.note: minus the minimum: tau is nonnegative for a PSD P

bloch_gradients.kinetic_matrix.note: relative: 1/2 <grad chi_m|grad chi_n> = _kinetic[m, n]; the gap is the alias mean of |G+k|^2 against the square of the mean G+k

bloch_sums.psi_difference.note: the first k-point of the crystal is KPoint.psi: exact (not stored: the setup freeze holds psi)

bloch_sums.image_sum.note: relative: the plain sum over lattice images of exp(i k.R) chi(r - R) at 40 grid points (the test of bloch_values), independent of the C/Rust kernel

bloch_sums.im_over_max.note: non-vacuity: a generic k makes the Bloch sums complex

projections.kpoint_difference.note: the first k-point is KPoint.projections (the (M, P) block the crystal stores)

magnetization.pauli_trace.note: m_a = tr(rho sigma_a) with explicit Pauli matrices; array maximum 0.07476

magnetization.collinear_limit.note: P = diag(Pa, Pb): mz = rho(Pa) - rho(Pb), mx = my = 0

spinor_kinetic_energy_density.collinear_.note: P = diag(Pa, Pb): tau = tau(Pa) + tau(Pb), tau_z = tau(Pa) - tau(Pb), tau_x = tau_y = 0

dense_compensation_gradient.fd_abs.note: per Bohr; dU/dR_A = grad (delta_aA - delta_bA), A = atom 1, step 0.0001

valence_shares.sum_to_one.note: exact: the shares of a point sum to 1

dense_compensation.kernel: screened, omega = 0.11 Bohr^-1: 4 pi (1 - exp(-q2 / 4 omega^2)) / q2, pi / omega^2 at q = 0

mesh_wedge_refusal.message: the k-point mesh is not symmetric under k -> -k
